policy.similarly_equipped: every hop endpoint carries the same relay-enabled Annex L terminal id; cross-terminal or cross-protocol chains are not printed and stay pending
policy.peer_graph: the existing communications Configuration per-unit fits, directed peers and peer_fits are the fixed author peer graph; no reciprocal edge is inferred and absent names are dead edges
policy.eligibility: same side, alive, operational per hop; intermediates send+receive; the receiver only receives; enemy units are never considered
policy.per_hop_qualification: each hop passes the existing links::route: compatibility, Annex L platform binding and printed surface/air LOS caps, unmanned gate, CaS radio-pair room gate, declared LOS transport range and the author antenna horizon
policy.purity: relay conveys the sender snapshot unchanged: no new report, no new FCS, no quality rewrite, no die, no per-hop delay; find_path is a read-only deterministic BFS in unit-name order
policy.determinism: fewest hops first, exact unit-name order tie-break, identical result after save/restore
